who.text: God, Paul, Silvanus, Timothy and the Thessalonians.

where.text: Written after Paul's hurried departure from the city.

when.text: Commonly dated around AD 50-51, likely Paul's earliest letter.

what.text: Paul encourages a young church, commends their faith, and answers questions about the return of Christ and holy living. Genre: Epistle.

before.text: Follows the founding of the church in Acts 17.

stakes.text: The church stands firm in hope as it awaits Christ.
